## About
Your Car Specialists is a full service repair shop on Marquardt Ave in Santa Fe Springs, right around the corner from our old spots on Rosecrans. We started out working on Hondas and grew into a shop that services all domestic and most foreign vehicles, including diesels and hybrids.
Rick Warner built this place on honesty and on putting customers ahead of the bill. Steve Bazar carries that on today as owner, with technicians Greg Dickason and Carlos Juarez in the shop. Some families have trusted us with their cars for generations.
Customers give us 4.8 stars from 53 Google reviews, and the word that comes up is honest. If something isn't broken, we'll tell you so.

## Services
- Oil service: Routine oil service to keep your car running right.
- Brake service: Inspection and service of your brake system.
- Tires: Tire replacement for your car or truck.
- Transmission and engine repair: Repair work on transmissions and engines.
- Check engine light repair: We find and fix the cause when your check engine or service engine soon light comes on.
- Diesel and hybrid service: Service and repair for diesel engine vehicles and hybrids.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: We service all domestic vehicles and most foreign vehicles. Give us a call and we can tell you about yours.

Q: Can you help if my ABS or traction control light comes on?
A: Yes. We can diagnose and repair your vehicle when those lights come on.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
